name: cursor-workflows-starter
description: Starter kit: workflows determinísticos sobre o Cursor SDK, invocáveis pelo chat do Cursor IDE (MCP) e pelo terminal (CLI).

scripts.check:log: npm run check > .check.log 2>&1; e=$?; grep -E '^# (tests|pass|fail) |^not ok' .check.log; echo EXIT=$e; exit $e
scripts.typecheck: PATH=node_modules/typescript/bin:$PATH; tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/dashboard/app && tsc --noEmit -p packages/dashboard/run-view && tsc --noEmit -p test && tsc --noEmit -p packages/runtime/test && tsc --noEmit -p packages/dashboard/test
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present; w=$?; tsx --test --test-timeout=120000 test/*.test.ts; r=$?; exit $((w || r))
